Version 1.0.3

- Updated skill name in metadata from "phy-otel-audit" to "OTel Audit"
- Bumped metadata version to 1.0.3
- No other changes to usage, features, or code described in SKILL.md

- Updated metadata version from 1.0.1 to 1.0.2 in SKILL.md.
- No other changes to functionality or documentation content.

- Updated author to "Canlah AI" in metadata.
- Updated metadata version to 1.0.1.
- Added "homepage: https://canlah.ai" to the skill metadata.

- Initial release of phy-otel-audit (v1.0.0): a zero-dependency OpenTelemetry instrumentation auditor for Node.js, Python, Go, and Java.
- Scans code for 10 types of missing or misconfigured OTel instrumentation, including HTTP handlers without spans, untraced database calls, missing service.name, and propagation errors.
- Outputs actionable findings with severity levels (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW), per-file coverage scores, and code fix suggestions.
- Supports usage in CI pipelines with options for severity filtering and detailed output.
- No external dependencies required.
